Game Overview

In Dolls War, the core idea is straightforward: join Tom, a junior agent on a perilous mission to outsmart mafia forces. Engage in heart-pounding battles using a selection of weapons, from pistols to powerful bombs. Climb the ranks with each victory and prove your prowess in this gripping fight for survival and justice.
